Thiruvannamalai (film)
Thiruvannamalai is a 2008 Indian Tamil masala film written and directed by Perarasu. It stars Arjun Sarja, Pooja Gandhi, Karunaas, Sai Kumar, and Vidharth. The music was composed by Srikanth Deva. The film was later dubbed in Hindi as "Main Hoon Vinashak" and in Telugu as "Jai Sambasiva".
